name: Supplementarity for π/4
summary: The π/4 and 5π/4 Z-states plugged into an X-spider give the phase-free X-state, up to a scalar.
description:
The instance $\alpha=\pi/4$ of [supplementarity](../supplementarity/), with the right-hand side simplified using the [Hopf rule](../hopf/): two arity-one Z-spiders with phases $\frac\pi4$ and $\frac{5\pi}4 = \frac\pi4+\pi$ attached to the same X-spider are, up to a scalar, equal to that X-spider alone, i.e. to the state $\ket{0}$.

This is the simplest equation of the Clifford+T fragment that cannot be proven with the rules that are complete for the Clifford fragment (stated without scalars). It is why the Clifford+T fragment needs additional axioms such as supplementarity.

source.location: Section 4 (supplementarity for α = π/4 is not derivable)
